translations.web: A spirit came out and stood before Yahweh, and said, ‘I will entice him.’
translations.bsb: Then a spirit came forward, stood before the LORD, and said, ‘I will entice him.’ ‘By what means?’ asked the LORD.
translations.kjv: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before the LORD, and said, I will persuade him.
translations.asv: And there came forth a spirit, and stood before Jehovah, and said, I will entice him.
